plugins.description: RYUX, design intelligence for AI agents and designers: one skill with five entry points. Analyze an existing interface, Design without code, Build in your stack, Critique a Figma link, pen.dev design, website URL, or screenshot, and QA the result. RYUX reads only the knowledge each task needs.
